profile.headline: Senior Engineer Manager at Major League Baseball
profile.summary:
I delivered on all my IT projects.  Been through many major production system launches. Crunch time is show time for me.  I'm not the guy who leaves before the project ends and claim it on the resume.  Any seasoned IT professionals will know what I mean by that.

Specialties: AWS, NodeJS, OpenAPI, Java/J2EE, Spring, Hibernate, OpenJPA, Swagger, Apache Camel, OAuth2, JWT, Azure APIM, OpenId Connect, JPA, Maven, Git, Subversion, Mustache, REST, Soap, SOA, AOP, MVC, CXF, ServiceMix, Jersey, Hibernate, Oracle/ATG Commerce, WebSphere Commerce, Endeca, Google Web Toolkits, JSTL, JUnit, Ant, Log4J, VB for application, SQL, Tomcat/TomEE, Websphere, Oracle, DB2, SQL Server, PL/SQL, JavaToCics gateway, VSAM access thru Java, CVS, SourceSafe, Eclipse, Javascript, JQuery.

positions.title: House wife
positions.description:
- Home automation via Wink Hub and IFTTT and voice control via Alex and Google Assistant.
- Video editing via Adobe Premiere Pro....Love adding cinematic LUTS to my 4K 23.98fps footage.
- Setup IP Cam security system with motion detection and automatic email notification.
- Custom build HTPC with large RAID 5 media storage array.
- IKEA kitchen design software expert.
- Build a playset, gazebo....I mean assembled.
- Extensive knowledge of mobile devices because I own a lot of them.
- Landscape design, implementations when heavy lifting is not involved.
- Professional TV watcher, Seriously...my work at ABC is part of the system that broadcast to your TV.
- Interior design (Re-painted rooms and made many furniture recommendations to "The Woman").
- Fixed anything that leaks, lose or broken for project "money pit"  aka "home ownership".
- Feed the kids, dress the kids...etc.
- Yes, I can cook too.

positions.title: Tech Lead/System Architect
positions.description:
No BS Description: 

It's the Scholastic Digital Portal/Platform.  https://digital.scholastic.com

AWS System Architect work:

-Migrated Scholastic Digital Application platform from an outdated VPC account to a new account with many service upgrades to handle 5 times more traffic while adding the latest and greatest operational readiness monitoring tools and alarms.  Lead a team of DevOps engineers to provision over a dozen AWS services/products for the platform via Terraform scripts.  Designed migration strategy and phases ensuring minimum system outage.  Performed and orchestrated live production cutover.

-Replaced a very high volume and costly public API set (exceeding one million calls per hour) used by all of Scholastic digital applications to collect detailed usage statistic.  Previous implementation was running on 80+ dedicated servers with 40+ DB servers and dozens of scheduled python jobs backing multiple PHP web applications.  New solution employs a serverless AWS solution that can handle 5 times more traffic with sub 150 milliseconds response time.

Lead Developer work:

-Lead Developer of a Spring Boot backend for Scholastic digital web portal and supporting REST-APIs.  These web applications utilized Spring technologies such as Spring-Session, Spring-Cache via Redis, Spring-data, Spring-Security and Spring-Core.  Setup Jenkins jobs, Maven poms and Git repositories to support continuous build and deployment on AWS while integrating with SonarQube for continuous code inspection.

-Lead implementation of a highly scalable and cost effective solution for Scholastic Digital Session Management system using AWS serverless Lambda technologies and NodeJS.

-Enhanced system performance by added caching layer thru ElastiCache with Redis.

positions.title: Tech Lead
positions.description:
No BS Description: 

When you are paying $$$$$$$$$ to SalesForce every year and replace it with an in-house solution for a lot less $ (in 4 months).  Plus it's doing a better job because it's custom.

-Working with international team members across Europe to analyze various systems in production to create functional requirements for a new in-house replacement system from an existing Salesforce application.
-Implemented and designed Spring API application and backend jobs running complex business algorithm used to manage and distribute Avon sales leads.
-Major refactoring and redesign of Avon Global Service Platform.  Mavenized and refactored dozens of J2EE based services and migrate over to Artifactory.  Using Swagger based API first approach and customizing and its’ code generation capability.
-Architect Azure API Manager solution to front and authenticate all existing service calls on the platform.

positions.title: Lead Enterprise Developer
positions.description:
No BS Description: 

When you turn on your TV and watch ABC network....and you are not getting blank screen.  Yeah, It's that system.

-Analyze existing broadcasting playback automation and traffic systems to developed Dub List Generation engine and browser based UI for broadcast operators.
-Extensive use of Hibernate with CXF and Spring frameworks to support SOAP messaging based SOA architecture.
-Restful web service integration with automation vendor via Apache CXF and Camel to leverage out of the box enterprise integration patterns and components for complicated polling and multithreading control.
-Design and implement custom high availability solution for automatic failover and backup support in a mission critical 24/7 environment.
-Lead and convert a team of .Net developers to Java developers.

positions.title: Sr eCommerce Developer
positions.description:
No Bull description:

IBM Websphere Commerce

Scholastic Reading Club site(s) - one for teacher and one for parent.

This is the system you go to when your kid comes home with one of those Scholastic book club flyer. There's a teacher version of the site with tons of administration and recommendation functionality as well.

Re-worked much of these 2 sites, front and back.

Back-End: 
-Integration of in-house Single Sign On/Login framework into Websphere Commerce Suite.
-Add Endeca search, type ahead, search result paging and sorting through extensive use of Endeca’s API.
-Leveraged Endeca engine to render product pages to minimize performance hit on traditional Database System. 
-Reworked all checkout related functionality for an overhaul of site’s checkout experience.
-Developed custom parent/teacher relationship based shopping cart to support physical and digital items. 
- Suggested and implemented various security enhancement.
-Performance enhancements such as HTML page fragment caching, smarter Ajax retrieval logic and various Database query tweaks.
-Integration of company proprietary user profile, address book and credit card system.
Front-End: 
-Remove GWT from site and move to more developer friendly Ajax/JQuery/JSP based architecture.
-Incorporate dynamic Endeca driven browse, product and catalog pages throughout the site.
-Ajax interaction with shopping cart, promotion and checkout pages.
-Merge various login pages into one universal fragment and fully integrated with existing content management system.

Other:
-In charge of build process and staging deployment.
-Migration of source code management to subversion.
-Take ownership of all source code branching and merging activities to support multiple concurrent development work streams.


Served as a mentor and helped many developers who I consider great friends. REALLY

positions.title: Consultant - Sr. E-Commerence Analyst
positions.description:
No BS description:

SOA behind the scene via ESB, MQ as JMS SOAP messaging with XMLBean, mainly an ATG Dynamo site on the frontend for the Bookspan (now Direct Group) book clubs (20+ club sites)  Eg. www.bomc2.com, www.bomcclub.com

Mainly working on the ATG application tier and some back office tool with Google Web Toolkit, Spring, Struts and Hibernate.

Worked on some architect/Design work on a new Columbia House DVD club site with Spring MVC and Hibernate.  Cart, Order History, Address Book.

Currently doing some enhancement here and there for the newly launched multi-clubs platform.

positions.title: Sr. Analyst
positions.description:
No BS Description:

Implemented and designed new product for mass mailing (multi-offers).  Ported some existing functions to Struts and Hibernate.  Went thru many many lines of really messy codes and lead effort in documenting what the hell they are doing.

positions.title: Vice President - Architect, Commercial Online Banking
positions.description:
No BS Description:

It's Citibank's Online Banking on steroid.  Implemented and helped designed a lot of the key security features under the hood.  Security is pretty important here since the backend handles more than a Trillion dollars per month.  Ported the web application to Struts and Hibernate.  Had to extend Struts a little so it behaves nicely on OS/390 platform, over USS of course.

Other key function designs and implementations -
ARP issue file upload.
Opening escrow account.
End user system administration.
ACH return file reporting.
CitiDirect integration.
SSO to wire system integration with consumer online banking site
...etc...etc...too many to name, great manager and team hence lots of interesting works.

positions.title: Consultant - Lead Web Analyst and Architect, Commercial Business Web Portal
positions.description: ATG Dynamo web portal with Teamsite content center for Small Business.  Automated tons of stuff with Teamsite and its' OpenDeploy so business can add new sections and pages without any code changes.  It actually eliminated needs of other developers as a result...oops

positions.title: Consultant - Sr. E-Commerence Analyst
positions.description:
ATG Dynamo.
Great and tight team, rewrote JCrew.com and delivered in a little over 5 months.  Did all design and coding for user personalization, customer related modules, tracking, localization.  Data migration from old platform to new.  Didn't sleep for 3 days straight during launch but it was well worth it.  Now go buy some stuff from there.

positions.title: Sr. E-Commerence Analyst
positions.description: ATG Dynamo, build a major CD selling site in 4 months with only a hand full of developers.  Pretty good teamwork there.
